WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
aggregate_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(project_count) as total_projects,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.archstat,
    sc.project_count,
    CAST(sc.project_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(a.total_projects AS FLOAT) as share,
    CAST(1 AS FLOAT) / CAST(a.num_statuses AS FLOAT) as avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN aggregate_stats a
)
SELECT 
  archstat,
  project_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: NULL/missing values in archstat are treated as a distinct status group; SQL GROUP BY naturally segregates NULLs
Distinct projects are counted once per status, even if multiple QC records exist for the same project-status pair
